items.reason: OracleText byte-identical to Scryfall; sentence 1 -> modifyPT (Target creature, -5/-5, untilTime Turn/End), sentence 2 -> death-replacement (OriginalEventOccurs:false, exile it) with DyingObject:It anaphora; fully structured, no unparsed/free-text; mirrors landed Incendiary Flow family

Emits modifyPT SpellAbility + linked death-replacement StaticAbility matching gold; cited CR 614.1/614.6/700.4 all exist and match modeling; that-creature/it anaphora -> ObjectReferenceKind.It per UntapThatCreatureRule/ThreatenRule convention

New optional DyingObject ObjectReference is a sound generalization: pins one already-identified object by anaphoric reference, orthogonal to the inherited filter-scoped AffectedObjects axis (reference-not-resolution, ADR 0004); null-omitted for filter-scoped death events; CR 700.4 dies-citation correct

No new discriminator introduced (newAstNode=false); modifyPT, replacement, death event, and exile all already project in PortGraph/PortWalkProjection (replacement=intercept+inner-emit CR 614, modifyPT=modify:pt emit); DyingObject is a reference refinement, not a projection-relevant discriminator, so no new PortWalk entry required
